claim_scope: Pure neighborhood Deffuant–Weisbuch dynamics with one independently uniform sampled edge per time step on a fixed three-node undirected path, 0<rho<=1/2, 0<epsilon<=1, and initially ordered opinions a0<=c0<=b0 with distinct leaves.
integrity: Self-contained mathematical derivation; finite checks supplement but cannot replace infinite-time probability proofs. No independent audit, literature novelty certification, or generalization beyond stated hypotheses.
scientific_limitations: No claims for larger networks, dyadic-neighborhood mixtures, adaptive graphs, different edge sampling, or general initial orders. The stationary affine law and classic stubborn-agent fluctuations are previously known; only the model-specific sharp confidence dichotomy is presented as potentially new.
title: A sharp three-agent confidence threshold between consensus and persistent opinion fluctuations
